name: Rhys ap Gruffydd
bio: Rhys's journey into motorsport began with a childhood obsession with rally cars tearing through the Welsh countryside. After graduating with a degree in mechanical engineering from Cardiff University, he started his career as a junior engineer with a small racing team competing in national championships. His meticulous approach and knack for problem-solving quickly saw him rise through the ranks, gaining experience in chassis development, aerodynamics, and engine performance. Rhys is known for his data-driven decision-making and his ability to translate complex technical concepts into actionable strategies. He believes in fostering a collaborative environment where engineers are empowered to push the boundaries of innovation while maintaining a focus on reliability and performance.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave
physical.description: Rhys has a lean build and a focused gaze, often seen with a tablet displaying telemetry data.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on a specific brand of Welsh tea being available in the engineering office at all times.
